desc: A seat changing hands, the guests' clocks apart: three games together in the plaza, guest 1's clock 10 minutes ahead of guest 2's (TTYD_NET_MS_OFFSET: a computer booted that much earlier). Guest 2 (seat 3) asks for seat 2 and guest 1 says yes, so seats 2 and 3 swap at the next calm moment; the host forgets seat 2's own-character reports when its holder changes, so guest 2's reports (on a clock behind guest 1's) count from the first and its game walks the partner itself (it once refused every one of them as older: the seat stayed held and the partner never walked). Guest 1 then walks seat 3's companion too.

log_must: co-op: player 3 to seat 2 \(seat 2's player 2 to seat 3\)
co-op: seat 2's own-character reports forgotten \(its holder changed\)
co-op: seat 2's character walked by player 3's own game
co-op: seat 3's character walked by player 2's own game
test: this player says yes to player 3 for seat 2
co-op: this guest walks its own character \(seat 3\)
test: this player asks for seat 2
co-op: this guest walks its own character \(seat 2\)
